ideas.title: Investigating the Impact of the Federal Funding Freeze
ideas.description: This story would investigate the impact of the federal funding freeze on various projects and programs, including the Gateway Tunnel.
questions: What is the extent of the federal funding freeze?
How will it impact the Gateway Tunnel project?
ideas.insight: The federal funding freeze could have far-reaching consequences for various projects and programs. It's essential to investigate the impact and hold those in power accountable.
